fields.System.Title: INV-502 — Release a reservation
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a single way to release a reservation, so that every path that
cancels or supersedes a promise returns the stock to availability.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a reservation, when it is released, then qty_reserved decreases,
  • availability increases, and the reservation row is closed.
  • - Given a partial release, then only the released quantity returns to availability.
  • - Given an already-released reservation, when release is called again, then nothing
  • changes and no error is raised.
  • - Given every caller — order cancel, quality hold, wave cancel, short pick, transfer
  • cancel — then each uses this single method.
  • - Given a release, then it happens in the same transaction as the change that caused it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, reservation |
| Risks | A release path someone forgot ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration (one per calling path) · idempotency |
